title: VendPoint Retired Item Vend Errors — Desk Reference and Vend Error Credit Entry
content:
## Retired items that keep vending

The retired item is the item of the customer's contract price line written as a removal carrying the highest change reference on the customer's agreement (removal lines are change lines, whose references Corbett issues in sequence); once its contract price ends Corbett loads no more of it, and the machine may still log a vend of it after its stock has run out, a vend that dispenses fewer units than it logs.

A vend error is credited only when it is reported no later than the model's vend error reporting window, in hours, after the failed vend, except that the failed vend of a retired item that Corbett finds from the item's stock ledger, for a retired item whose shortfall is no more than the units of its latest vend and only for such a vend, is credited by Corbett without a report at the late-find share of what was billed for the units it did not dispense, as figured below.

While the shortfall is above zero and no more than the units of the latest vend, Corbett owes one vend error credit against the latest vend, recording the units it did not dispense, the unit price billed on that vend and the credit value figured below, credited once like any vend error; a retired item without a shortfall, or without a vend on the machine, is owed no credit, and a retired item whose shortfall is more than the units of its latest vend stays under the base vend error rules.

A credit so figured that is no larger than the model's desk limit for vend error credits is recorded from the machine log; a larger one waits for the next restock visit, as any larger vend error credit does.

These rules belong to the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program; the retired item's removal line is read from the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement.

### Scope at a glance

| Retired item on the machine | Under this rule |
|---|---|
| Shortfall above zero and no more than the units of its latest vend | One vend error credit owed by Corbett against the latest vend, without a report |
| No shortfall | No credit owed |
| No vend on the machine | No credit owed |
| Shortfall more than the units of its latest vend | Stays under the base vend error rules |

| Credit figured | Recorded |
|---|---|
| No larger than the model's desk limit for vend error credits | From the machine log |
| Larger | Waits for the next restock visit |

## The credit entry: `credit_retired_item_vends_2f4f7780`

**Capability.** The tool records a vend error credit on a VendPoint machine: a new machine transaction of type vend error credited is recorded against the named vend, dated today, carrying the next error credit reference in sequence, one above the highest error credit reference on record. The item, product category, cost center and unit price are copied from the named vend; the units credited and the credit value are the values given. The credit value is added to the machine's consigned stock value.

**Invocation.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls `credit_retired_item_vends_2f4f7780` with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `vending_machine_id` | The reference number of the VendPoint machine placement the credit is recorded on, as returned by the machine lookup |
| `original_txn_reference` | The vend transaction number of the vend being credited exactly as it appears on the machine's transactions, copied character for character |
| `quantity` | The number of units credited: a whole number greater than zero, with no decimal part |
| `credit_amount` | The credit value: a US dollar amount, zero or more, with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` with the text `credited`, `vending_txn_id` (the new transaction), `txn_reference` (the error credit reference, letters VE, a hyphen and digits), `original_txn_reference` echoed back, `sku` (the item copied from the named vend), `quantity` (units credited as an integer), `extended_amount` (the credit value in USD with two decimals) and `event_date` (today in YYYY-MM-DD form).
